75378-needwood-forest.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. arkling winds along:  Then, as the pausing zephyrs breathe,  The billowy mist recedes beneath;  Slow, as it rolls away, unfold  The vale’s fresh glories green and gold;  DOVE[1] laughs, and shakes his tresses bright,  And trails afar a line of light.

arxiv-2105-04639.title: Cross-Corpora Language Recognition: A Preliminary Investigation with Indian Languages
arxiv-2105-04639.creator: Spandan Dey 1 , Goutam Saha 1 , Md Sahidullah 2
arxiv-2105-04639.description: Abstract In this paper, we conduct one of the very first studies for cross-corpora performance evaluation in the spoken language identification (LID) problem. Cross-corpora evaluation was not explored much in LID research, especially for the Indian languages. We have selected three Indian spoken language corpora: IIITH-ILSC, LDC South Asian, and IITKGP-MLILSC.

arxiv-2105-05131.title: Trace theorem and non-zero boundary value problem for parabolic equations in weighted Sobolev spaces Thanks: D. Kim and K. Woo were supported by Basic Science Research Program through the National Research Foundation of Korea (NRF) funded by the Ministry of Education (2019R1A2C1084683). Thanks: K.-H
arxiv-2105-05131.creator: Doyoon Kim, Kyeong-Hun Kim, Kwan Woo
arxiv-2105-05131.description: Abstract . We present weighted Sobolev spaces ℌ ~ p , θ γ ​ ( S , T ) \widetilde{\mathfrak{H}}_{p,\theta}^{\gamma}(S,T) and prove a trace theorem for the spaces. As an application, we discuss non-zero boundary value problems for parabolic equations.

arxiv-2108-09534.title: Theoretical Analysis and Evaluation of NoCs with Weighted Round-Robin Arbitration Thanks: This work was supported by Strategic CAD Labs, Intel Corporation, USA.
arxiv-2108-09534.creator: Sumit K. Mandal, Jie Tong, Raid Ayoub, Michael Kishinevsky, Ahmed Abousamra, Umit Y. Ogras
arxiv-2108-09534.description: Abstract Fast and accurate performance analysis techniques are essential in early design space exploration and pre-silicon evaluations, including software eco-system development. In particular, on-chip communication continues to play an increasingly important role as the many-core processors scale up. This paper presents the first performance analysis technique that targets networks-on-chip (NoCs) that employ weighted round-robin (WRR) arbitration.

arxiv-2204-04552.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by M. Ledesma‑Motolinía, J. L. Carrillo‑Estrada, A. Escobar, F Donado, Pavel Castro-Villarreal. It has been shown that a nonvibrated magnetic granular system, when it is feeded by means an altenating magnetic field, behaves with most of the distinctive physical features of active matter systems.

arxiv-2205-13247.title: Constraints on the Transition Redshift using Hubble Phase Space Portrait
arxiv-2205-13247.creator: Darshan Kumar 1, Deepak Jain 2, Shobhit Mahajan 1, Amitabha Mukherjee 1, Akshay Rana 3
arxiv-2205-13247.description: Abstract One of the most significant discoveries in modern cosmology is that the universe is currently in a phase of accelerated expansion after a switch from a decelerated expansion. The redshift corresponding to this epoch is commonly referred to as the transition redshift z t z_{t} .

arxiv-2207-10738.title: Real-time estimation of the effective reproduction number of COVID-19 from behavioral data
arxiv-2207-10738.creator: Eszter Bokányi, Zsolt Vizi, Júlia Koltai, Gergely Röst, Márton Karsai
arxiv-2207-10738.description: Abstract Near-real time estimations of the effective reproduction number are among the most important tools to track the progression of a pandemic and to inform policy makers and the general public. However, these estimations rely on reported case numbers, commonly recorded with significant biases.

arxiv-2209-06018.title: An Analysis of Collocation on GPUs for Deep Learning Training
arxiv-2209-06018.creator: Ties Robroek IT University of Copenhagen titr@itu.dk, Ehsan Yousefzadeh-Asl-Miandoab IT University of Copenhagen ehyo@itu.dk, Pınar Tözün IT University of Copenhagen pito@itu.dk
arxiv-2209-06018.description: Abstract Deep learning training is an expensive process that extensively uses GPUs, but not all model training saturates modern powerful GPUs. Multi-Instance GPU (MIG) is a new technology introduced by NVIDIA that can partition a GPU to better-fit workloads that do not require all the memory and compute resources of a full GPU.

arxiv-2211-12221.title: Virtual Reality in University Teaching: Experiences from a Computer Science Seminar
arxiv-2211-12221.creator: Enes Yigitbas
arxiv-2211-12221.description: Abstract Due to the corona pandemic, numerous courses were held using digital solutions in order to be able to continue teaching. Conventional collaboration tools (Zoom, Big Blue Button, etc.) were used in particular to digitally map a synchronous session for teaching and learning purposes.

arxiv-2306-05422.title: Tracking Everything Everywhere All at Once
arxiv-2306-05422.creator: Qianqian Wang, Yen-Yu Chang, Ruojin Cai, Zhengqi Li, Bharath Hariharan, Aleksander Holynski, Noah Snavely, [0.5em] Cornell University Google Research UC Berkeley
arxiv-2306-05422.description: Abstract We present a new test-time optimization method for estimating dense and long-range motion from a video sequence. Prior optical flow or particle video tracking algorithms typically operate within limited temporal windows, struggling to track through occlusions and maintain global consistency of estimated motion trajectories.

arxiv-2404-07256.title: Hot New Early Dark Energy bridging cosmic gaps: Supercooled phase transition reconciles (stepped) dark radiation solutions to the Hubble tension with BBN
arxiv-2404-07256.creator: Mathias Garny 1, Florian Niedermann 2, Henrique Rubira 1, Martin S. Sloth 3
arxiv-2404-07256.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Mathias Garny 1, Florian Niedermann 2, Henrique Rubira 1, Martin S. Sloth 3. We propose a simple model that can alleviate the H 0 H_{0} tension while remaining consistent with big bang nucleosynthesis (BBN). It is based on a dark sector described by a standard Lagrangian featuring a S ​ U ​ ( N ) SU(N) gauge symmetry with N ≥ 3 N\geq 3 and a massive scalar field with a quartic coupling.

arxiv-2407-00878.title: A Robust Power Model Training Framework for Cloud Native Runtime Energy Metric Exporter
arxiv-2407-00878.creator: Sunyanan Choochotkaew, Chen Wang, Huamin Chen, Tatsuhiro Chiba, Marcelo Amaral, Eun Kyung Lee, Tamar Eilam
arxiv-2407-00878.description: Abstract Estimating power consumption in modern Cloud environments is essential for carbon quantification toward green computing. Specifically, it is important to properly account for the power consumed by each of the running applications, which are packaged as containers. This paper examines multiple challenges associated with this goal.

arxiv-2409-03932.title: Mixing Skyrmions and Merons in Topological Quasicrystals of Evanescent Optical Field
arxiv-2409-03932.creator: H.J. Putley, B. Davies, F.J. Rodríguez-Fortuño, A.Yu. Bykov, A.V. Zayats
arxiv-2409-03932.description: Abstract Photonic skyrmion and meron lattices are structured light fields with topologically protected textures, analogous to magnetic skyrmions and merons. Here, we report the theoretical existence of mixed skyrmion and meron quasicrystals in an evanescent optical field. Topological quasiperiodic tilings of even and odd point group symmetries are demonstrated in both the electric field and spin angular momentum.

arxiv-2601-11836.title: Trace Validation of Unmodified Concurrent Systems with OmniLink
arxiv-2601-11836.creator: Finn Hackett, Evan Wrench, Peter Macko, A. Jesse Jiryu Davis, Yuanhao Wei, Ivan Beschastnikh
arxiv-2601-11836.description: Abstract . Concurrent systems are notoriously difficult to validate: subtle bugs may only manifest under rare thread interleavings, and existing tools often require intrusive instrumentation or unrealistic execution models. We present OmniLink , a new methodology for validating concurrent implementations against high-level specifications in TLA + .

pmc-12368072.title: Solution-sheared supramolecular oligomers with enhanced thermal resistance in interfacial adhesion and bulk cohesion
pmc-12368072.creator: Gang Lu, Rui Ma, Yuanyuan Zhao, Dianyu Wang, Wentao Shang, Huaguo Chen, Shahid Ali Khan, Ming Li, Eduardo Saiz
pmc-12368072.description: Developing strong, thermally resistant adhesives for load-bearing applications remains challenging. Here we report a class of solution-sheared supramolecular oligomers that exhibit exceptional adhesive strength and toughness across a broad temperature range. These adhesives achieve a debonding work up to 23.6 kN/m and a lap shear strength exceeding 30.

pmc-12607111.title: An anti-adhesive peptide found in extracellular vesicles from Sporothrix brasiliensis and Sporothrix schenckii
pmc-12607111.creator: Cássia M. de Souza, Nicolly A. Sensato, Flavia C.G. Reis, Mayra S.S. Pinheiro, Marlon D.M. Santos, Amanda C. Camillo-Andrade, Patricia Shigunov, Haroldo C. de Oliveira, Paulo C. Carvalho, Taícia P. Fill, Marcio L. Rodrigues
pmc-12607111.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Sporothrix brasiliensis and Sporothrix schenckii are major causative agents of sporotrichosis, a neglected fungal disease with growing public health relevance. These pathogens release extracellular vesicles (EVs) that contribute to host–pathogen interactions, yet their small molecule content remains unexplored. Here, we isolated EVs from both species following growth on solid medium and characterized them using nanoparticle tracking analysis, transmission electron microscopy, proteomics, and untargeted metabolomics.

pmc-12722298.title: Germination control by a hard seed coat: insights from a tropical legume
pmc-12722298.creator: G F Pereira, M C Sanches, O C De-Paula, T A A Vaz, G S Oliveira, A G Rodrigues-Junior
pmc-12722298.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Classifying seed dormancy is an essential task for plant propagation; however, several plant species lack information about the kind of dormancy the seeds have or inaccurate reports are passed on without an in-depth investigation. We investigated Copaifera langsdorffii, a widespread tropical species with several contrasting reports about seed dormancy in the literature, particularly on the role of their hard seed coat on germination control.

pmc-12780258.title: Maximization of bioactive potential of Fomes fomentarius via artificial Intelligence-Assisted optimization
pmc-12780258.creator: Emre Cem Eraslan
pmc-12780258.description: In this study, in order to maximize the biological activity of the medicinal mushroom species Fomes fomentarius, extraction parameters were evaluated by Response Surface Methodology (RSM) and Artificial Neural Network-Genetic Algorithm (ANN-GA) hybrid optimization. The effects of extraction temperature, time and ethanol/water ratio on total antioxidant capacity (TAC) were modeled.

pmc-12830771.title: Comparative genomics reveals avian Acinetobacter baumannii as antimicrobial resistance reservoirs and bovine strains with elevated pathogenicity
pmc-12830771.creator: Dadimi Bhargavi, Sandeep Ghatak, Kandhan Srinivas, Madesh Angappan, Daniel Aibor Pyngrope, John Pynhun Lamare, Samir Das, A. A. P. Milton, Chendu Bharat Prasad
pmc-12830771.description: Multidrug-resistant Acinetobacter baumannii is primarily known as an opportunistic nosocomial pathogen but is increasingly recognized as an emerging contaminant in foods of animal origin. In the present study, we characterized the A. baumannii strains from raw meat samples and undertook a comparative genomic analysis to explore the resistome, virulome, mobilome (integrons and transposons) and pathogenic potential of the A.

Regarding the current understanding of their relationship, on the other hand, human activi-ties on land usage or land covers may also increase the fluctuations.

pmc-13364028.title: Experimental Demonstration of Geometric Tilt-to-Length Noise Model in Test Mass Interferometer
pmc-13364028.creator: Mengyang Zhao, Jia Shen, Shaoxin Wang, Keqi Qi, Heshan Liu, Peng Xu, Ruihong Gao, Ziren Luo
pmc-13364028.description: Space-based gravitational wave detection missions impose extremely stringent requirements on the measurement precision of the laser interferometer, where tilt-to-length coupling noise emerges as a critical factor degrading performance. This paper focuses on geometric tilt-to-length noise in the test mass interferometer, conducting both theoretical modeling and experimental validation.

pmc-13659236.creator: Jeffrey B Krall, Lily G Beck, Parker J Nichols, Robb Welty, Quentin Vicens, Morkos A Henen, Beat Vögeli
pmc-13659236.description: ZBP1 senses foreign nucleic acids in the unusual, left-handed Z-conformation via binding through its Zα1 and Zα2 domains and initiates cell death pathways that enable viral clearance. dsDNA and dsRNA can adopt Z-conformations; however, both typically require chemical modifications or protein binding to induce Z-form conversion and stabilization.
